datasets.name: Landslide inventory vector file (Jiuzhaigou)
datasets.source: Key Laboratory of Active Tectonics and Volcano, Institute of Geology, China Earthquake Administration
datasets.verbatim: We are especially grateful to the Key Laboratory of Active Tectonics and Volcano, Institute of Geology, China Earthquake Administration for the inventory vector file of landslides triggered by the 8 August 2017 MW 6.5 Jiuzhaigou Earthquake, China.

methods.name: Fully convolutional spectral–topographic fusion network (FSTF-Net)
methods.summary: FSTF-Net is an end-to-end deep learning model for landslide extraction that uses two parallel branch networks: one for optical RGB imagery (using ResNet50 and ASPP) and another for multi-source data (slope, aspect, and NDVI, using VGG-16). The features from these branches are concatenated and processed through a decoder to produce pixel-level landslide classification.
methods.verbatim: Based on the idea of feature-driven classification, the landslide extraction model of a fully convolutional spectral–topographic fusion network (FSTF-Net) based on a deep convolutional neural network of multi-source data fusion is proposed

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned but not linked, and the other input datasets are not linked or accessible. The custom code for the FSTF-Net model is not provided or linked.
